title: A filtered colimit of smooth algebras is a filtered colimit of standard smooth algebras
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\Lambda$ a commutative $R$-algebra which is a filtered colimit of smooth $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras]. Then $\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of standard smooth $R$-algebras: there are a small filtered category $\mathcal K$ ($\mathcal K$ has at least one object, any two objects of $\mathcal K$ map to a common object, and any two parallel arrows $a,b:k\to k'$ are equalized by some arrow $c:k'\to k''$, $c\circ a=c\circ b$), a functor $k\mapsto C_k$ from $\mathcal K$ to the category of commutative $R$-algebras (transition maps homomorphisms of $R$-algebras) such that every $C_k$ is a standard smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra], and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $\iota_k:C_k\to\Lambda$ such that $(\Lambda,(\iota_k)_{k\in\mathcal K})$ is a colimit of the diagram $k\mapsto C_k$ in the category of commutative $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07CI (lemma-colimit-standard-smooth, line 675) with its proof (lines 681-691: Algebra Lemma Tag 07C3 lemma-when-colimit and Lemma Tag 07CH lemma-smooth-standard-smooth)

proof.text: Let E be the set of all standard smooth R-algebras in universe max u v. Each member is finitely presented, by Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.finitePresentation. The factorization criterion already handles the small representatives needed for this set, so literal polynomial representatives need not be constructed again here.

For any finitely presented R-algebra A and algebra map alpha:A→Λ, apply Algebra.exists_smooth_factorization_of_ind_smooth to obtain a smooth R-algebra B and maps beta:A→B and delta:B→Λ with delta.comp beta = alpha. This proved helper includes the underlying-ring colimit and finite-presentation factorization steps, with the required universes.

Apply Algebra.Smooth.exists_standardSmooth_retract to B, obtaining C standard smooth and maps iota:B→C and rho:C→B with rho.comp iota = id. Take beta′ = iota.comp beta and gamma = delta.comp rho. Associativity of AlgHom.comp and the retraction identity give gamma.comp beta′ = delta.comp beta = alpha. Bundle C and these algebra maps in CommAlgCat.

Apply CommAlgCat.exists_filtered_colimit_of_factorization to E, the finite-presentation proof from step 1, and the factorizations from steps 2–3. Package its small filtered diagram, compatible maps, and colimit witness as a ColimitPresentation. Every stage belongs to E, hence is standard smooth, so this is ObjectProperty.ind of standard smoothness at Λ.

mathlib_candidate.how: In a finitely accessible category, ind P X iff every map from a finitely presentable object to X factors through an object satisfying P. Applied to C = CommAlgCat R with P = smooth and P = standard smooth (Mathlib's Algebra.IsStandardSmooth, submersive presentations, itself to be compared with Stacks' standard smooth), the item would follow from it and the retract lemma 07CH, but this Mathlib has no IsFinitelyAccessibleCategory instance for CommAlgCat R and no retract lemma 07CH; not a leaf (point B8).
